# tools: add rtun as alternative to ngrok.com

Try [reverse-tunnel](https://github.com/snsinfu/reverse-tunnel) (`rtun`), a self-hosted reverse tunnel, as a replacement for the [ngrok](https://ngrok.com) service ([#131](DOT-130.md)). **Motivation:** "to compare in the future" — own server instead of a SaaS account and token.
